statuses.adapted-unverified: A native implementation is exported, but the complete acceptance matrix is not closed.
statuses.planned: Required for the first stable release but not yet exported.
statuses.deferred: Excluded from the current port and parity scope until explicitly needed. Not exported or claimed as compatible.

entries.notes: The compound InputGroup, Content, List, Item, Group, GroupLabel, Separator, Empty, Collection, and useFilter surface is native. Free-form controlled text, automatic and custom object filtering, item commits, Field integration, hydration, and representative visuals are covered.
Compact inline-link detection uses exact Kumo Link element identity, matching React Kumo.
Mobile collapse + Clipboard ported; SkeletonLine loading preserved.
Shelved at user request; revisit when chart support is needed.

Standalone and compound Group, Item, and Legend APIs are native. Controlled and uncontrolled state, form values, label activation, indeterminate and disabled states, group accessibility, SSR/hydration, and representative visuals are covered.

Native div ref, all sizes, alternate copy text, callbacks/labels, animated icons/live feedback, tooltips and anchored copied toasts. Uses the shared copy helper with no false success, per-instance toast managers instead of the oracle's global manager, portal-provider routing, tooltip role/description linkage, and async/timer cleanup. Icon transitions exclude hover colors.
Legacy escaped text with native styles, five language variants and Code.Block identity. The values prop remains accepted but unused, matching the pinned implementation.
Legacy plain-text wrapper, identical to Code.Block; distinct from the trusted-HTML code/server renderer.

Root, Trigger, Panel, DefaultTrigger, and DefaultPanel are native. The panel is kept mounted only during SSR hydration to avoid a detached Octane insertion anchor when opening an initially closed Base UI disclosure; normal post-hydration mounting behavior is preserved.

The compound TriggerInput, TriggerValue, TriggerMultipleWithInput, Content, List, Item, Chip, Input, Empty, Group, GroupLabel, Collection, Trigger, Value, Icon, and useFilter surface is native. Object values, filtering, single and multiple selection, controlled chips, render composition, hydration, and representative visuals are covered.

Full compound surface on native ARIA Autocomplete/ListBox and Base UI Dialog. Typed grouped iterators, value filtering, native click and modifier-Enter semantics, disabled skipping, focus restoration, portal routing, highlight ranges, loading/empty/footer, hydration and browser fixture. Noninteractive results are disabled for keyboard too; native highlight reasons and client-created dialog portals are documented. Results owns the collection inside the List scrolling wrapper.

Native day-picker v10 adapter preserves the six Kumo selection unions, onChange naming, default outside days/animation, Phosphor chevrons, style/component overrides, locale and navigation. Events, footer and component props are native. Common v9 focus/month/year aliases are mapped; removed v8-era class/style keys, components.Button, and fromDate/toDate are not supported. Callback presence controls selection, and multiple max resets match the oracle. This is not a React differential parity claim.

Deprecated two-month, 42-day calendars preserve size/variant exports, local selection callbacks, hover/focus previews, reset, editable months and display-only timezone. First-of-month navigation prevents month-end skips; invalid edits are ignored; unused duplicate IDs and color transitions are removed. It remains a tab-through legacy button grid, not DatePicker's roving keyboard calendar. Server and client must agree on initial local month and locale.

Controlled confirmation dialog with exact/case-insensitive matching, native input events, sizes, caller-owned error/loading, async activation guard, fallback clipboard and live feedback, close/unmount cleanup. Ported from the pinned blocks implementation while preserving its root export; also available at components/delete-resource.

Standard and alert-dialog roots, compound members, portal routing, controlled state, native change details, focus restoration, hydration, and React Kumo styling metadata are covered. The portal shell is kept mounted only during hydration to avoid Octane's detached insertion-anchor failure.

Root, composed Trigger, Content, Item, LinkItem, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup, RadioItem, RadioItemIndicator, Group, Label, Separator, Shortcut, and submenu APIs are native. Roving focus, selection, links, nested menus, hydration, and representative visuals are covered. The portal shell is kept mounted only during hydration.

Native Diagram/Node/Parallel/List/Anchor composition retains pure layout and SVG routing. Native pointer/wheel panning replaces motion/react. DOM-ordered descendant registration handles keyed reorders; structural value updates propagate branch alignment. Native useRender preserves descriptor refs/handlers without imposing default node styling on custom renders. Resize measurement, disabled connectors, horizontal anchors, bounds/overflow and SSR node adoption have focused evidence; exhaustive geometry/browser parity remains open.
Native textarea events and refs, Field associations, controlled and uncontrolled values, min/max row auto-resizing, cleanup, SSR/hydration, and representative visuals are covered.

The complete Input, Addon, Suffix, Button, Label, and Description compound API is native. Container, individual, and hybrid focus modes, inherited state and sizing, native refs and events, Field integration, SSR/hydration, and representative visuals are covered.
Octane Base UI useRender preserves callback and element composition, including handlers, styles, and refs.
Octane Base UI useRender preserves callback and element composition; useLinkComponent is preserved.
The deprecated icon-button API, active id/index matching, tooltip labels, and wrapping horizontal focus navigation are native.

Compound and legacy APIs, caller-controlled pages, internal input drafts, page-size and page-number Select adapters, localized labels, known/unknown totals, and SSR/hydration are native. Empty totals stay on page one with range 0-0; non-finite drafts restore the current page, fractions truncate, and Enter prevents form submission. These are intentional corrections to oracle edge cases, not exact differential parity.

Root, Trigger, Content, Title, Description, and Close are native. Render and deprecated asChild composition, dismissal, portal routing, hydration, and representative visuals are covered. The portal shell is kept mounted only during hydration.

The generic compound Group, Item, and Legend API is native. Accessible naming, controlled and uncontrolled selection, native details, keyboard navigation, typed values, form serialization, group states, card appearance, SSR/hydration, and representative visuals are covered.
Direct generic RadioGroup export aliases the compound Radio group root.
Shelved at user request; revisit when chart support is needed.

Primitive and object values, item maps and arrays, disabled descriptors, controlled multiple selection, read-only options, render composition, Field integration, hydration, and representative visuals are covered.

Empty, masked, and revealed states; pointer and keyboard operation; controlled and uncontrolled values; native refs and form behavior; Clipboard API and fallback copying; accessible instructions and announcements; Field integration; SSR/hydration; and representative visuals are covered.

Octane-native full compound API. Tests smoke-render the provider/header/content/menu/footer path; responsive mobile, peek, resize, and scrollToItem behavior remain unverified. ScrollArea has no @octanejs/base-ui counterpart so Content uses a plain overflow viewport preserving data-sidebar attributes; mask-fade dropped. Collapsible is custom (no Base UI dep).
Deprecated compat wrapper over LayerCard preserves color/as->render mapping and inherited callback composition.

Standalone and compound Group, Item, and Legend APIs are native. Controlled and uncontrolled state, label activation, native form behavior, disabled and read-only states, group accessibility, SSR/hydration, semantic-token visuals, and transitioning state are covered.

All ten compound parts, intrinsic refs and native attributes/events, layout and row variants, compact/sticky headers and columns, Checkbox-backed selection, event details and deprecated callback alias are native. Selection and pagination data remain caller-owned; ResizeHandle is only a styled event target, not a resizing engine.

Controlled and uncontrolled values, manual and automatic activation, render composition, styling metadata, overflow controls and drag scrolling, roving focus, and hydration are native. WAI-ARIA tab behavior is implemented at the Kumo boundary because @octanejs/base-ui 0.1.48 omits tab children from server output.
Textarea is a public alias of InputArea.
Shelved at user request; revisit when chart support is needed.

Exports native Toast compound parts plus Toasty/ToastProvider, useKumoToastManager/createKumoToastManager and Kumo option types. Preserves external upserts versus hook-side duplicate bump/ending semantics, variants/content/actions, typed data and promise transitions. Explicit portal container overrides context. Providers must mount before external dispatch; portal DOM is client-created. Bump frames are cancelled on unmount, toast text is 14px and close-button space is reserved. Toasty.variant remains accepted but unused as in the oracle. Native primitives own timeout/pause, limit, stacking and dismissal; no exhaustive React differential claim.

Root, Button, Link, Input, and InputGroup preserve grouped styling, inherited sizing and disabled state, disabled focusability, text-input cursor navigation, roving focus, and hydration. The composite behavior is native because @octanejs/base-ui 0.1.48 has no toolbar module.
Trigger composition, focus/Escape interaction, portal routing, SSR/hydration, and an open browser-rendered state are covered. Broad upstream differential and accessibility parity remain open.

codeSubpaths.notes: Preserves client props/types, aliases, lazy JavaScript/WASM engines, dual themes, fallback, line numbers/highlights and labels. Native provider owns/disposes asynchronous engines, deduplicates equivalent language sets and resets failures on reconfiguration. Copy uses the shared fallback helper, reveals keyboard focus and cleans up timers; inherited object names are rejected. No Shiki modules are reachable from root component exports, and code entry static imports contain no Shiki implementation.

Native trusted-HTML renderer and shared lazy Shiki loader, canonical language options, JavaScript default and reusable disposal. One-off highlighting disposes via finally even when rendering fails. No React differential parity claim.

primitivePolicy: Only Octane-native primitive subpaths are eligible for export. Missing primitive families remain explicit gaps rather than ReactCompat fallbacks.
